# UNREVIEWED. No speaker of this language has read this file.
# Written in the syllabary (Noto Sans Cherokee is bundled; Windows also has it
# in Gadugi). Only everyday words are here: yes, no and the colours. The
# Cherokee Nation's Language Department made computer terms with Google and
# Microsoft (Gmail, Windows, Office); a speaker or the Language Department
# (language@cherokee.org) is the right source for the rest.
# The rest of the interface is deliberately NOT filled in: a line left out
# falls through to English, and English is better than invented technical
# vocabulary put into the mouth of a living language.
# So this is a starting point for a speaker to correct, not a translation.
# The picker says so, so that choosing it is an informed choice.
# To help: each line is english<TAB>translation, and tools/add_translations.py
# checks the file every way it can be broken silently.
# Deckboy interface catalogue.
# Broadcast vocabulary is deliberately left in English where the trade leaves
# it there: TAKE, PROGRAM, NDI, SRT, OSC.
# What the desk face says when you switch to this language: a local saying, not a translation.
# --- tutorials: tools/lesson_strings.py (a whole line each) ---
# --- end of tutorials ---
